PocketPad splits naturally into two paths: Bluetooth HID sessions that emulate USB-class devices after pairing (no Companion software on the host) and optional Wi‑Fi / UDP Companion on Windows for dashboards, KM pairing tokens, multicast discovery, and extremely low jitter when lots of phones connect at once. Get the Android app on Google Play.
No install on hosts that accept standard HID pairings.
Separate registration paths for generic gamepad emulation vs composite keyboard/mouse — switch modes requires re-pairing on most OSes following the in-app “Prepare” flow.
Media & TV remotes send multimedia scan codes usable with smart TVs, Fire sticks, Kodi, VLC, Netflix UIs.
PocketPad Companion bundles discovery, pairing codes for Universal layouts, and a live dashboard.
Companion auto-runs LAN listeners optimized for multiplayer — multiple phones negotiating independent sessions concurrently.
On Windows, install Companion from PocketPad Overview (Windows installer EXE — checksums in README.txt).

The Windows installer adds ViGEmBus when it is not already on your PC—the driver Windows needs so virtual gamepads show up in games. If ViGEmBus is already installed, setup skips that step. License texts: THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt. PocketPad terms: EULA.
Layouts & full configurability via drag edits, clones, joystick logic, tilt-to-steer, steering curves.
Universal fullscreen: huge touchpads, clipboard-friendly typing overlays, WASD slabs, programmable macros.
Presentation & media modes map to shortcuts for PowerPoint, Google Slides, YouTube-focused keys, VLC, etc.
Wake sleeping hosts — Bluetooth radios pause HID until active.
Some TVs mute local speakers while treating the phone like a headset; disable Bluetooth media audio when that happens.
Keep Companion + phones on same AP band to avoid jitter; multicast discovery requires same subnet.
ViGEmClient (vigemclient.dll, MIT) ships with Companion and is removed when you uninstall PocketPad.
ViGEmBus (BSD 3-Clause) is a separate Windows driver. The installer adds it only when missing; on uninstall you can keep or remove it. Choose keep if other apps (e.g. DS4Windows) still use ViGEmBus.
